title: Cozy Cat Cafe: Coloring Book for Adults and Teens
subtitle: Bold and Easy Kawaii Designs Featuring Cats, Cozy Cafe Scenes and Cottagecore Moments for Relaxation
description:
Step into a world where cats brew coffee, bake cakes, and curl up with a good book — all inside the coziest cafe you've ever imagined.


Cozy Cat Cafe is an adult coloring book filled with charming kawaii scenes of cats living their best cafe life. Each page invites you into a warm, inviting moment — from a tabby barista crafting the perfect latte to a fluffy cat tucked into an armchair with a steaming mug and a great story. These illustrations are drawn with love, designed to slow you down and bring a smile to your face.

What's Inside:
• 30 unique bold-and-easy illustrations with a cozy cottagecore aesthetic
• Scenes featuring cat baristas, reading nooks, cafe kitchens, and baked goods
• Single-sided pages to prevent bleed-through and protect your artwork
• Large 8.5 x 11 inch pages for comfortable, relaxed coloring
• Clean bold outlines with large open shapes — perfect for colored pencils, markers, and gel pens

Perfect For:
• Stress relief and mindfulness after a long day
• A thoughtful gift for cat lovers, coffee enthusiasts, or cottagecore fans
• Cozy evenings at home with your favorite warm drink
• Beginners and experienced colorists who love cute, simple designs

Grab your colored pencils and find your calm in the coziest cat cafe in town.
Every page is a little escape — a moment to breathe, color, and enjoy the simple, quiet joy of a perfectly cozy afternoon.

cover_prompt: Full-color warm cozy illustration of a charming cat cafe interior with kawaii aesthetic. A cheerful tabby cat barista wearing a small apron stands behind a wooden counter lined with steaming mugs, layered cakes on cake stands, and vases of wildflowers. Cozy armchairs and round wooden tables fill the foreground. Hanging Edison bulb lights, shelves of vintage teapots and potted succulents decorate the walls. A large window reveals a soft rainy afternoon street scene. Warm golden light fills the room. Rich, inviting colors — terracotta, cream, warm brown, sage green. DO NOT include text in image.
